title: pteracanthus tibeticus
intro: Pteracanthus tibeticus, commonly known as Chinese cat's whisker or Yin chen hao, is a traditional Chinese medicinal plant that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and asthma, as well as having anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pteracanthus tibeticus include its ability to induce sweating, promote diuresis, and calm the mind and body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include eugenol, eugenol acetate, and other terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
